01 — The Lanes

Thirty-eight lanes. Zero bad seats.

02 — Kitchen & Bar

Pull up a chair at Lane 39.

Our 39th lane serves the best frame of the night — an extensive kitchen menu hot off the grill and a fully stocked bar. Come for the bowling, stay for the bite.
